name: smwmusic-tiger-mission-high-score
title: Tiger Mission - High Score
description:
A calm, soothing track best used for overworlds and credits.
The high score theme from the Commodore 64 game Tiger Mission, composed by Johannes Bjerregaard.
This port is specifically based off the remix by Drax (Thomas Mogensen), which was used for the Fairstars MP3 Recorder keygen.
Also known as Infinitode 2 - DQ4.
